note: As "a wallet short of funds", but by the time Send again is pressed the chain's clock is within a minute of the plan's deadline (control.advance 850, one block). The SDK doesn't send the same plan again (IN_FLIGHT, ALREADY_ATTEMPTED): the banner says it is too close to its deadline, with nothing to press. The chain passes the deadline and finalizes past it; the banner proves it never went out (EXPIRED), and Send again plans it anew and sends it: Saved · confirming. Two wallet requests, one broadcast.
